requirements.requirement: Set node1's persistent system hostname to os-lab.infra.test.
requirements.summary: The kernel hostname, static hostname, and /etc/hostname all matched os-lab.infra.test before the restart and again after a confirmed change in boot identity.

requirements.requirement: Ensure node1 can resolve os-lab.infra.test locally.
requirements.summary: Before and after restart, getent resolved os-lab.infra.test to 127.0.1.1 and the corresponding /etc/hosts entry was directly observed.

overall_summary: Both material task outcomes are satisfied with direct post-restart evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is coherent and complete for node1: it records a healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement, observed disruption, a changed boot identity independently corroborated by lifecycle snapshots, and recovery to a running system with the required hostname and local resolution preserved.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The /etc/hosts and hostname changes were directly required by the task, while sync and the transient scheduled reboot served the mandatory restart protocol. The restart completed cleanly; final observations show no failed services, unchanged socket exposure apart from expected process identifiers, healthy package state, and only normal reboot-generated systemd temporary-directory turnover.
